title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE

We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.

In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.

Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.

Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

  • Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
  • Automated coding and billing optimization
  • Intelligent claim follow‑up to reduce denials
  • Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements

Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.

WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU

This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.

You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Very hands‑on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!

1. Build and Refine AI Products
  • Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
  • Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
  • Use AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
  • Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
  • Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
  • Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
  • Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
  • Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
  • Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
  • Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
  • In the near future, contribute to fine‑tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE1. Technical Skills
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
  • Hands‑on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
  • Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
  • Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
  • Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
  • Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
  • Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, ever‑changing startup environment
  • Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
  • A self‑starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
  • Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
  • Experience with AI‑assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
  • Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
  • Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
  • Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
  • Ground‑floor opportunity in a stealth‑mode company with massive market potential
  • Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
  • Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
  • Work alongside world‑class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
  • Access to cutting‑edge LLM technologies solving complex, real‑world problems
  • Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
  • Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work‑Life Integration
  • Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
  • Fast‑paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
  • Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
  • Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?

If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.

Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:
Growth Marketer – Part-Time (Grow into Head of Marketing)

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services.

Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B. I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground.

We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that - if you are a runner and marketeer - probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban. You'll be working on a newsletter, an email that lands in your inbox from Brooks, Lululemon or Abbott World Marathon Majors, and other times, results come from your structured and clever efforts over time. Not because we got it right the first time, but because we kept on researching, learning, testing and voilà – now you nailed it!

Our clients include US Bank, Goldman Sachs, Amex, Google, Accenture and runners of equal awesomeness from all over the world! We also work with some of the biggest names in the running industry (NDA signed) and in the future, with your help, many more…right?

I am looking for someone in constant growth mode. Growth in terms of always looking for new opportunities to grow the business. Growth in terms of testing an initiative in one city and then scaling it to the rest of our destinations. Growth in terms of taking the time to research new tech, new ways of doing things, and current trends.

Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset who puts their Sherlock Holmes hat on will, without a doubt, be able to optimise this tremendously.

You will also own our digital advertising efforts. That means planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle. You’ll also get to create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas that help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations. If you spot a gap, we want you to fill it (and we’ll back you while you do).

You will work directly with me. I love my job, and every day I am utterly grateful that I work in a company with a concept that "makes sense" to me, and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful, and positive. We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you – running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast‑moving, and positive company should.

Contract Details
  • USD 1,400 a month
  • 25 hrs a week
  • Managed via Upwork

Oh, and hey… if you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. I don’t believe in my colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow… the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

Thanks for reading this far,

Lena

title: Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing
description:
Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing

Join to apply for the Growth Marketer In Global Running Company - Part-Time With Room To Grow Into Head Of Marketing role at Go! Running Tours

Hi… My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast‑paced, bullet‑pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Growth Marketer with Go! Running Tours.

Our new Growth Marketer will be responsible for all our marketing activities for B2C and B2B clients. Our current markets are growing (some by 100+%) and we are constantly looking for new channels and markets to sell our services. Your marketing DNA has to be of the rare kind that is analytical and structured, while also having the creativity to craft great copy, see new opportunities, and connect the dots between B2C and B2B.

I am looking for a colleague who works systematically with new ideas and markets, has attention to detail, and gets super excited about the responsibility you are given and the fact that the world is your marketing playground. We are lucky that sometimes amazing opportunities (that if you are a runner and marketeer—probably will make you do cartwheels) land in our turban.

You’ll be working on a newsletter, email flows, and other communications.

  • Email marketing is a strong channel of ours, and if you get a thrill from optimising flows, building smart automations, and digging into data to make things work better and smarter, then this is your playground. We already send regular newsletters that do well, but someone with a data/automation mindset can optimise this tremendously.
  • You will also own our digital advertising efforts, planning and running campaigns on Meta and Google, exploring new platforms, and keeping an eye on what actually moves the needle.
  • You’ll create clever case studies, explore sponsorship opportunities, and pitch bold ideas to help us reach new runners, new companies, and new destinations.
  • We want you to fill gaps and we’ll back you while you do.

We work remotely and have only 2–3 hours of internal meetings a week. All other time is reserved for deep work and basically getting things done. There is always time for a call, and we are all on Slack, so you’re never left alone in any way. We’re just on the other side of the world.

The salary is not one that will secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius (at least not to begin with). It is a salary that should be comfortable and is based on reduced working hours, so you can have a fun and fulfilling life besides work. The money should not be the main motivation for you;
running, bridging cultures, and being part of a fun, fast-moving, and positive company should.

Contract Details Are As Follows
USD 1,400 a month
25 hrs a week
Managed via Upwork

If you’re considering this role as an add‑on to an already existing full‑time job, then hold your horses. We don’t believe in our colleagues working 60+ hours a week, and it simply doesn’t align with our company values. We want you to have the energy, focus, and headspace to do great work and enjoy life outside of it.

The most important traits to bring to the role are being a fast mover, a super collaborator, and having a drive to grow—both the business and yourself. But the most important skill of all is: execution. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.

If you feel this role could be for you, then please write to me via ****** with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours. (No AI please—we want to know the real you, not the ChatGPT version).

Thank you for reading this far, Lena.

Note: we usually take down our job posts within 3‑4 days as we receive many applicants.

Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at Go! Running Tours by 2x.

title: Engenheiro De Dados Sr
description:
A Stone:

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.


Como é ser um Egenheiro de Dados:

O Engenheiro de Dados será responsável por construir, implantar e otimizar pipelines de dados confiáveis e escaláveis, garantindo que os dados brutos sejam transformados em informações úteis e acessíveis para a tomada de decisões estratégicas e segmentação de jornadas no contexto de CRM. O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com analistas de negócios e equipes de TI para suportar diversas iniciativas orientadas por dados.


As suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Criar e gerenciar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT): Desenvolver fluxos automatizados e confiáveis para extrair, transformar e carregar dados de diversas fontes, utilizando ferramentas de orquestração.
  • Assegurar a qualidade dos dados: Implementar processos para monitorar a qualidade e a integridade dos dados, identificando e corrigindo falhas na estrutura para evitar comprometimento das análises e jornadas.
  • Otimizar performance: Monitorar o desempenho dos sistemas de dados e implementar melhorias para garantir o processamento rápido e eficiente de consultas e análises.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em SQL (Procedures, DML, DDL, Pipelines) & Python.
  • Plataformas de Nuvem: Experiência com serviços de nuvem (GCP, Amplitude, Salesforce Marketing Cloud) para armazenamento e processamento de dados.
  • Ferramentas de orquestração: Airflow e Cloud Functions.
  • Engenharia de Software: Conhecimento em boas práticas de codificação, versionamento (Git) e testes.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas e Pensamento Crítico: Habilidade analítica para identificar gargalos, depurar sistemas complexos e encontrar soluções eficazes de forma proativa.
  • Comunicação Eficaz: Clareza para explicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos não técnicos (como times de negócios e gestão), e vice-versa, garantindo o alinhamento de expectativas e resultados.
  • Trabalho em Equipe e Colaboração: Atuar de forma integrada com engenheiros de dados, analistas e outras equipes, contribuindo para um ambiente produtivo e sinérgico.
  • Orientação para Resultados: Foco em entregar soluções de dados que gerem valor real para o negócio e impulsionam a tomada de decisões.


Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Escala: 5x2 Segunda à sexta - de 08h às 17h ou de 09h às 18h.


Modelo/Local de trabalho:

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

title: Coordenador De Operações De Marketplaces
description:
Objetivo:


Você será o dono da operação de Violação Comercial em Marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shoppe entre outros), liderando o ciclo completo de proteção comercial de grandes marcas no ambiente digital: monitoramento, identificação de sellers, diagnóstico de violação, denúncias estratégicas, comunicação de adequação e acompanhamento da regularização.



Descrição de Responsabilidades:



Operação e Governança


  • Liderar o fluxo completo de Violação Comercial em marketplaces: setup → hunting → triagem → discovery → comunicação → penalidades → acompanhamento.


  • Garantir o monitoramento contínuo de preços, SKUs e sellers em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee, Magalu, Google Shopping).


  • Gerenciar processos de descoberta de sellers (CNPJ, nota fiscal, nome fantasia, múltiplos perfis).


  • Coordenar denúncias estratégicas (copyright/brand misuse) como ferramenta de identificação e adequação.


  • Pilotar a execução das trilhas de comunicação com sellers infratores até a adequação comercial.



Relação com o Time Comercial e Canais


  • Conectar regras comerciais, PMA sugerido e diretrizes de canal com a operação prática de marketplaces.


  • Auxiliar comercial em decisões de penalidades: bloqueio de venda, corte de desconto, suspensão de canal etc.


  • Dar visibilidade dos impactos de infrações para contas estratégicas e diretoria.



Produtos, Dados e Estratégia


  • Analisar curvas de preço, reincidência e impacto por SKU, sugerindo ajustes de PMA e clusterização.


  • Mapear padrões de violação (por categoria, seller, logística, campanhas).


  • Construir dashboards de oscilação de preço e saúde de canal (base no fluxo Data Studio citado nos treinamentos → ).



Processos e Eficiência

  • Estruturar runbooks, SLAs e rituais de operação.

  • Integrar tecnologia (crawlers, priorização, bases) aos processos humanos.

  • Garantir governança documental: versões de políticas, manuais, trilhas e templates.





Experiência técnica obrigatória


  • Expertise em marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee, Magalu), BuyBox, regras automatizadas de preço, robôs de repricing.


  • Vivência com moderação e derrubada de anúncios (copyright, trademark, identidade visual).


  • Forte entendimento de políticas comerciais (PMA sugerido, canais autorizados, preço online x físico).


  • 5–10 anos de experiência com e-commerce, marketplace, pricing ou governança de canais.


  • Histórico comprovado de operação em ambientes de alta complexidade comercial.


  • Desejável vivência em projetos de proteção de marca, compliance de preço ou inteligência de mercado.



Competências de Gestão


  • Capacidade de montar e liderar time operacional.


  • Visão crítica + capacidade analítica (dados, padrões, correlação de eventos).


  • Comunicação clara, pragmática e com postura consultiva diante da diretoria.



Soft Skills


  • Perfil investigativo (curioso, conectado aos detalhes).


  • Postura firme para lidar com sellers agressivos e grandes marketplaces.


  • Visão de negócio (margem, ruptura de canal, rentabilidade, ROI).

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). – Realizar levantamento, análise e mapeamento de requisitos funcionais e técnicos relacionados aos serviços e aplicações que serão migrados.

– Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e alinhamentos com áreas usuárias para entendimento dos processos atuais.

– Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, incluindo fluxos, diagramas, padrões de arquitetura, requisitos, regras de negócio e impactos da migração.

– Apoiar o time técnico definindo estratégias de migração, dependências, riscos e prioridades.

– Acompanhar o progresso das entregas, garantindo aderência ao escopo e acurácia das informações.

– Facilitar comunicação entre squads, engenharia e gestão do projeto.

– Atuar como referência técnica para direcionamento, tomada de decisão e esclarecimento de dúvidas.


O que você precisa ter:

– Experiência prévia como BA, Tech Lead ou função híbrida em projetos complexos.

– Vivência com projetos de migração de cloud GCP → AWS.

– Conhecimento dos principais serviços de GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub etc.) e seus equivalentes na AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SNS/SQS etc.).

– Capacidade de interpretar arquiteturas, integrações, APIs, bancos de dados e fluxos técnicos.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Inicialmente 2 meses, com chance de prorrogação.

title: Risk Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive enterprise risk management framework covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks across the organization.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing、scenario analysis、capital adequacy evaluations and other regulatory-mandated reviews.
  • Prepare, validate, and support all regulatory disclosures required of financial institutions and virtual asset service providers (VASPs) , ensuring accuracy and timely submission.

Margin-Account Risk Oversight

  • Lead the governance and oversight of margin-account operations , including:
  • Establishing risk policies for margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Defining and periodically reviewing maximum LTV ratios and haircut methodologies ;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring adherence to client and institutional exposure limits, capital buffers, and net-worth thresholds.
  • Continuously monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) across business functions, escalating breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board with clear remediation plans.
  • Operate as an independent second-line function , maintaining objectivity from commercial and trading activities while collaborating closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology.
  • Engage with internal/external auditors, regulatory bodies, and governance committees on matters related to risk management, capital adequacy, and prudential standards.
  • Promote a strong risk-aware culture by supporting ongoing training, communication, and enhancements to risk methodologies, models, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level experience in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within banks, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and proven capability operating as a second-line or independent control function .
  • Strong command of Central Bank of Brazil risk regulations, prudential rules, capital adequacy requirements, and VASP reporting obligations.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks , stress testing, scenario modeling, and margin-account governance involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field;
    postgraduate qualifications are strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, strong quantitative capabilities, excellent communication, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.

We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join a major UK retail group building a new Klarna-style fintech payments platform. Event-Driven & Distributed Architecture

Observability, Reliability & Performance

Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Enforce best practices for IAM, secrets management, encryption, and network security
  • Build guardrails, policies, and automated compliance into CI/CD and IaC workflows
  • Contribute to platform risk assessments and mitigation strategies

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with architects, platform leads, and product teams to translate requirements into technical designs
  • Work with developers to guide best practices for cloud-native builds
  • Mentor engineers in IaC, automation, and platform engineering patterns

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong experience with AWS (multi-account, networking, security, core services)
  • Excellent Terraform skills, building modular and production-grade IaC
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes / EKS or similar orchestration platforms
  • Experience with Kafka or other event-streaming technologies
  • Hands-on with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD)

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with service mesh, API gateways, or serverless components

What This Role is Not

  • Not day-to-day ops or support
  • Not traditional DevOps or SRE maintenance
  • Not basic provisioning or infra monitoring
  • Not a junior cloud role

This is a platform build position: architecture + IaC + automation + infrastructure foundations.

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Data Engineer with an AI/ML focus to join our client’s growing data & analytics team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who loves building scalable data pipelines, operationalizing machine learning workflows, and partnering closely with data scientists to bring models into production.


You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, modern data engineering frameworks, and Snowflake as a central data warehouse.
  • Architect and manage data workflows , ensuring accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor, and tune machine learning models .
  • Develop feature engineering pipelines , preprocessing workflows, and model-serving APIs.
  • Integrate data from various sources (APIs, databases, cloud storage, streaming platforms).
  • Implement MLOps best practices including versioning, CI/CD for ML, and automated retraining workflows.
  • Optimize data storage, compute usage, and performance within Snowflake and cloud-native tools (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Create and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and operational guides.
  • Monitor data system performance and recommend improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer , Python Engineer , or similar backend/data role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python , including building production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience with Snowflake —data modeling, Snowpipe, tasks, streams, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with AI/ML workflows : feature engineering, inference pipelines, or deploying models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS , GCP , or Azure ).
  • Experience using data orchestration tools like Airflow , Prefect , or Dagster .
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI , or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Spark , Databricks , or other big-data processing tools.
  • Experience ingesting and transforming data at scale on Snowflake , including optimization of virtual warehouses.
  • Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or other streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience working with Brazilian clients or LATAM distributed engineering teams.

Diagnosticar e resolver questões técnicas complexas relacionadas às implementações de brXM.

Supervisionar a entrega técnica completa dos projetos brXM, incluindo desenvolvimento, testes e implantação.

Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes de desenvolvimento multifuncionais para garantir a execução fluida dos projetos.

Garantir que as entregas técnicas atendam a altos padrões de qualidade e sejam entregues no prazo.


Mentoria & Compartilhamento de Conhecimento:

Orientar desenvolvedores juniores sobre as melhores práticas e novas funcionalidades do Bloomreach.

Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de metodologias internas, ferramentas e melhores práticas para implementações brXM.

Manter-se atualizado com as últimas tendências e atualizações no espaço de plataformas de experiência digital (DXP) e no roadmap de produtos Bloomreach.


Requisitos Técnicos:

Mais de 5 anos de experiência com plataformas CMS ou DXP de nível empresarial, sendo pelo menos 3 anos focados especificamente no Bloomreach Experience Manager (brXM).

Expertise profunda em desenvolvimento Java e no Spring Framework, incluindo Spring MVC, Spring Boot e Spring Security.

Experiência comprovada com os principais recursos do brXM, como o modelo Headless State (HST), Content as a Service (CaaS) e modelagem avançada de conteúdo.

Forte entendimento da arquitetura baseada em componentes do brXM e experiência no desenvolvimento de componentes personalizados, templates e plugins.

Conhecimento extensivo das APIs nativas do brXM para gerenciamento de conteúdo, usuários e personalização.

Especialização na integração do brXM com sistemas terceiros, como CRMs, PIMs, plataformas de e-commerce (ex: Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP Hybris) e ferramentas de automação de marketing.

Proficiência em tecnologias modernas de front-end (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript ES6+) e experiência com frameworks populares como React, Angular ou Vue.Js para construção de aplicações desacopladas ou headless.

Experiência com ferramentas de build e gerenciamento de dependências (ex: Maven, Gradle) e sistemas de controle de versão (ex: Git).

Familiaridade com práticas e ferramentas DevOps, incluindo pipelines CI/CD, containerização (Docker, Kubernetes) e infraestrutura em nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Experiência em tuning de performance e otimização de aplicações brXM, incluindo estratégias de cache e otimização de banco de dados.

Compreensão de tecnologias de busca e sua integração com brXM, especialmente Bloomreach Search ou Apache Solr/Elasticsearch.

Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Tecnologia da Informação ou área relacionada, ou experiência prática equivalente.


Qualificações Preferenciais:

Certificação Bloomreach Developer ou Architect.

Experiência com outros componentes da suíte Bloomreach (ex: Bloomreach Search & Merchandising, Bloomreach Engagement).

Experiência em ambiente de desenvolvimento Agile/Scrum.

title: Api Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for API Designer/Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Overview

The API Designer/Engineer is a pivotal role responsible for implementing API Design First principles to create scalable, secure, and consumer-centric APIs. The candidate will focus on designing API specifications and frameworks that ensure seamless developer experiences while meeting Customer's API standards and architectural guidelines.


Key Responsibilities

API Design & Development

  • Adopt an API Design First Approach : Leverage OpenAPI (Swagger), RAML, or AsyncAPI specifications to define APIs before implementation, ensuring clarity and alignment across stakeholders.
  • API Specification Creation : Design API specifications that adhere to Customer's API standards, covering endpoints, data structures, error handling, and response codes.
  • Policy Design and Configuration : Define and configure API policies (security, routing, transformation, throttling, etc.) using tools such as Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Mock API Development : Create mock APIs for early-stage validation and testing to facilitate integration and feedback before development.
  • API Testing : Perform unit testing of API specifications to ensure functionality, reliability, and adherence to defined standards.
  • Environment Configuration : Configure API backend settings within APIM (naming conventions, App Insights, Key Vault) in DEV, UAT, and PRD environments.
  • API Deployment : Deploy draft APIs into the Azure APIM Dev instance and promote them across DEV, UAT, and PRD environments using the API DevOps framework.
  • Documentation : Create comprehensive API documentation, including references, developer guides, and examples, in line with Customer's standards.
  • Metadata Publishing : Publish API Identity Cards (metadata, usage information) to the Azure API Management Developer Portal to enable easy discovery and adoption by consumers.


API Consumer Onboarding

  • Secure Authentication Setup : Configure OAuth/OpenID Connect to ensure secure authentication and authorization for API consumers.
  • Subscription Key Management : Share API subscription keys securely with consumers and maintain robust tracking mechanisms.
  • Integration Testing Support : Collaborate with API consumers during integration testing to resolve issues and provide guidance on proper usage.


Testing & Validation

  • Functional Testing : Conduct and support API functional, integration, and performance testing to validate API readiness and scalability.
  • Mock and Staging Environment Management : Ensure availability of mock services and staging environments for API testing and feedback gathering.


Skills and Expertise

  • API Design First Expertise : Proficient in designing APIs using OpenAPI, SwaggerHub, or similar tools with a focus on consumer-first design principles.
  • Azure API Management : Deep experience in configuring and managing APIs using Azure API Management.
  • Security Standards : Strong knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and API key management best practices.
  • Documentation Excellence : Skilled in creating developer-friendly documentation and API identity cards.
  • Testing Proficiency : Familiarity with API testing frameworks and methodologies to validate functionality and performance. Proficient in using Postman tool


What can you expect from us?


- Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

- Opportunities to work outside Brazil

- A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Lead Wordpress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google,, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Platform Architect
description:
Role Summary

The Platform Architect will serve as the technical “north star” for the design, integration, and evolution of the NexusOne data platform for customer deployments and large programs.

This individual will architect the platform, define integration points, and design scalable, secure solutions based on incoming enterprise requirements using the NexusOne platform. They will participate in architecture review boards and ensure that all implementations align with NexusOne’s composable, open-source design principles. This role is forward-facing and requires a customer-centric mentality.


Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and evolve the end-to-end NexusOne platform across on-prem, hybrid, and cloud environments based on customer requirements and limitations.
  • Design and designate integration points for data services, pipelines, orchestration, governance, and security layers.
  • Translate solution requests and business requirements into scalable, compliant architecture blueprints.
  • Lead and participate in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs) to align deployments with enterprise standards.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design patterns, and integration frameworks .
  • Guide platform engineers and client teams in implementing best practices for security, observability, and reliability.
  • Oversee the selection, integration, and tuning of open-source components such as Airflow, Spark, Trino, YuniKorn, Superset, S3, NiFi, Ranger, and DataHub.
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership to evolve the NexusOne “North Star” architecture and roadmap.
  • Mentor engineers and collaborate with DevOps, Security, and DataOps to drive alignment and platform maturity.


Must-Have Core Skills

  • Core Expertise: Spark, Trino, Airflow, NiFi, YuniKorn, Superset, Iceberg, Ranger, DataHub, S3.
  • Infrastructure & Automation: Terraform, Kubernetes (K8s), OpenShift (OCP), Docker, Linux.
  • Security & Governance: IAM, SSO, KMS, Kerberos, Encryption, RBAC.
  • Monitoring & Observability: Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus.
  • Programming: Java, Scala, Python (preferred).
  • Architecture Practices: Solution design, reference architectures, system modeling, scaling patterns.

description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Recife / Brasilia

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care‑free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as an MSL with expertise in T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As an MSL – Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision‑makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Head of Marketing Germany (f/m/d)

Nufarm. Evolving Ag.

Nufarm is a global crop protection and seeds technologies company that helps farmers and businesses meet the global challenges of food, feed, fibre and food production.

Whether it’s commercialising the world’s first plant-based omega-3, launching precision agricultural solutions, unlocking biomass oils for more sustainable fuels and fast-moving consumer goods, launching innovative new crop protection solutions or delivering the crop and seed solutions farmers depend on every day, Nufarm is evolving with agriculture to drive value for customers .

Could this be you?

If you want to be a part of a thriving, supportive environment and are inspired by the prospect of being a part of something bigger, we’d love to hear from you.

Nufarm is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all Nufarm employees.
Apply today and be part of our journey to shape the future of agriculture!

title: Senior Data Scientist / Ml Engineer
description:
Project Description:

The primary goal of the project is the modernization, maintenance and development of an eCommerce platform for a big US-based retail company, serving millions of omnichannel customers each week.

Solutions are delivered by several Product Teams focused on different domains - Customer, Loyalty, Search and Browse, Data Integration, Cart.

Current overriding priorities are new brands onboarding, re-architecture, database migrations, migration of microservices to a unified cloud-native solution without any disruption to business.


Responsibilities:

  • We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer with Machine Learning expertise and good understanding of search engines, to work on the following:
  • - Design, develop, and optimize semantic and vector-based search solutions leveraging Lucene/Solr and modern embeddings.
  • - Apply machine learning, deep learning, and natural language processing techniques to improve search relevance and ranking.
  • - Develop scalable data pipelines and APIs for indexing, retrieval, and model inference.
  • - Integrate ML models and search capabilities into production systems.
  • - Evaluate, fine-tune, and monitor search performance metrics.
  • - Collaborate with software engineers, data engineers, and product teams to translate business needs into technical implementations.
  • - Stay current with advancements in search technologies, LLMs, and semantic retrieval frameworks.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering, with a focus on Information Retrieval or Semantic Search.
  • Strong programming experience in both Java and Python (production-level code, not just prototyping).
  • Deep knowledge of Lucene, Apache Solr, or Elasticsearch (indexing, query tuning, analyzers, scoring models).
  • Experience with Vector Databases, Embeddings, and Semantic Search techniques.
  • Strong understanding of NLP techniques (tokenization, embeddings, transformers, etc.).
  • Experience deploying and maintaining ML/search systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (CI/CD, testing, version control, code review).

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.G., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Desenvolvedor Outsystem

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Cliente global de tecnologia, com presença no Brasil e em diversos setores industriais. Esta vaga está sendo divulgada como banco de talentos para uma demanda prevista para os próximos meses.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Senior Data Science Analyst para se juntar ao nosso time de Data Plataform.

O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de machine learning utilizando técnicas de classificação, regressão e clusterização;
  • Realizar testesde modelos de machine learning, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, testes A/B, testes de hipótese e validação cruzada;
  • Proficiente em feature engineering para otimizar os desempenhos dos modelos desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolvimentode modelos de machine learning em cima da plataforma databricks;
  • Manutenção de modelos existentes (Acompanhamento e eventuais retreinamentos) ;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências relevantes;
  • Contribuir parao desenvolvimento de práticas de MLOps..

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Machine Learning | Regressão, Classificação, Clusterização, Redes Neurais, Seleção de Features, Cross-Validation, "Curse of Dimensionality", Viés-Variânica, Explicabilidade de Modelos, etc;
  • Estatística Avançada | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, desing experimental, modelagem preditiva, otimização, testes de hipótese, regressão, modelagem e métodos;
  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar scrips e queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;
  • Modelagem Estatística & Advanced Analytics | NLP, Séries Temporais, Random Forests, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Clustering methods (e.G. K-means), Classification methods (Decision Trees/Random Forest), among others;
  • MLOps básico | para entender os desafios de se colocar um modelo em produção;
  • Experimentação | Testes A|B, Hipóteses, Modelos de Atribuição;
  • GrandesVolumes | Extrair e manipular grandes bases de dados, utilizando a stack de dados disponível.


FERRAMENTAS

  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Python ou R | Pra quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala, Java & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Teste de Hipóteses | Para suportar o processo de tomada de decisão e criar informação de suporte;
  • Databricks | Uso de clusters e workspaces para BigData.

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Fraud Risk Manager
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for a Fraud Risk Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on fraud prevention.

You'll act as the core fraud risk expert, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and design, implement, and oversee effective fraud controls across key local products.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Designing and enhancing fraud prevention controls within Brazil’s 1LoD framework, ensuring alignment with local BCB regulatory expectations and license requirements
  • Performing detailed fraud risk assessments across products (PIX, credit, cards, and business accounts), identifying control gaps and recommending practical mitigations
  • Leading the development and implementation of fraud prevention strategies, including creating and tuning transaction monitoring rules, leveraging data-driven models, and defining robust response workflows
  • Overseeing major fraud incidents and investigations, supporting containment, recovery, and required regulatory reporting processes
  • Partnering closely with Product and Data Science teams to improve automation, detection efficiency, and case triage logic, challenging the status quo for continuous improvement
  • Monitoring and analysing fraud trends and key performance indicators (KPIs) to produce actionable insights and dashboards for local management and committees
  • Strengthening fraud governance, ensuring clear documentation of risks, controls, and residual exposures to demonstrate control maturity during regulatory engagements


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in fraud risk management, prevention, detection, or Investigations within a financial institution or fintech
  • A deep understanding of fraud typologies, detection models, and control frameworks across payment and credit products (PIX, cards, credit)
  • Solid knowledge of local (BCB) FinCrime and fraud regulations and reporting obligations
  • Hands-on experience creating, tuning, and validating fraud detection rules and working with model performance metrics
  • Experience leading complex investigations end-to-end, identifying control weaknesses, and proposing remediation
  • The ability to navigate ambiguity, connect data to risk impact, and design pragmatic, scalable solutions
  • A proven ability to partner with Product, Data Science, and Compliance teams to implement risk controls effectively
  • Great communication skills to relay complex fraud and regulatory topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences


Nice to have


  • Proficiency in using analytical tools (e.G., SQL, Python, Looker)
  • Confidence in presenting risk insights, fraud trends, and remediation updates
  • An interest in developing junior team members as the function scales


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.

  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills;
    ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws;
    must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment;
    5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours
