title: Principal Ai Engineer - Ai In Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:

We are looking for a Domain Architect Cybersecurity , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid / Remote , in the city of Belo Horizonte - MG.


In this role you will:

The Domain Architect – Cybersecurity has a strategic role in protecting critical operations in Brazil and Canada, designing, implementing and governing robust information security architectures. He will work in the construction of integrated solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance, cyber risk management, incident response and protection of digital assets, industrial systems, networks and sensitive data in extremely complex and distributed environments.

This professional will support secure digital transformation, overseeing security frameworks, identity and access, encryption, advanced monitoring and compliance policies. He will work closely with technology, operations, governance, risk and physical security areas, working globally to ensure business continuity and cyber resilience.


Main Responsibilities

  • Define, govern and evolve cybersecurity architectural models and standards, aligning global frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, COBIT) to the specific needs of operations.
  • Lead security architecture projects and initiatives for multi-cloud, on-premises, networking, application, industrial IoT/IIoT, data, and mobility environments.
  • Design solutions for threat prevention, detection, containment and remediation, integrating SIEM, SOAR, EDR, IAM and advanced encryption systems.
  • Work in the definition of identity and access policies and controls (IAM, SSO, MFA), network segmentation, endpoint protection, vulnerability management and governance.
  • Promote integration between physical security, IT, OT, and operations teams to create resilient and secure environments.
  • Develop and validate business continuity, cyber disaster recovery, and incident response strategies.
  • Evaluate and implement innovative security solutions (Zero Trust, Cloud Security Posture Management, Threat Intelligence, security automation and orchestration).
  • Ensure compliance with the data protection laws and regulations of the countries where it operates (LGPD, GDPR, PIPEDA).
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation, safety plans, best practice guides, and training for internal teams.
  • Participate in technical communities, forums, audits and global compliance assessments.


Requirements and Competencies

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills)

  • Degree in Computer Engineering, Information Security, Systems or related areas.
  • Minimum experience of 8 years in cybersecurity architecture and governance, with relevant performance in complex corporate or industrial environments.
  • Deep knowledge in security frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, COBIT, ITIL).
  • Expertise in network, host, application, identity, data and cloud security (MS Azure Security, AWS Security, GCP Security).
  • Experience with advanced tools: SIEM, SOAR, EDR, IAM, DLP, cryptography, risk analysis, pentest, advanced monitoring.
  • Experience in protecting OT/IT environments, security integration between industrial systems, industrial networks and corporate IT.
  • Practice with vulnerability management, container/Kubernetes security, security automation, DevSecOps.
  • Fluent English for technical and strategic communication, advanced Portuguese for Brazil-Canada collaborative work.
  • In-depth knowledge of privacy regulations, data protection and legislation of the countries where it operates.


Soft Skills

  • Technical and consultative leadership, capable of influencing strategic safety decisions among global teams.
  • Analytical capacity and strategic vision to build resilient and business-aligned environments.
  • Clear and assertive communication with technical, executive and regulatory audiences.
  • Proactivity, adaptability and focus on delivering tangible and continuous protection to the business.
  • Multicultural, collaborative teamwork with high commitment.


Differentials / Nice to Have:

  • Certificações: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CCSP, Azure Security Engineer, AWS Certified Security, PMP, TOGAF.
  • Experience in secure digital transformation projects in mining, energy or regulated industries.
  • Working knowledge of emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence in security, blockchain, security orchestration.
  • Participation in global governance and compliance programs (SOX, Sarbanes-Oxley, GDPR).
  • Track record securely across hybrid cloud, containers, microservices, and industrial IoT environments.
  • Participation in global security communities, lectures, technical publications.

Expected Skills & Deliverables, Impact:

  • Integrated cybersecurity architecture and governance for Brazil and Canada, covering multiple environments and technologies.
  • Execution of strategic projects to strengthen the protection, prevention, detection, response and recovery of cyber risks.
  • Dissemination of policies, planning and training, creating a culture of security and continuous compliance.
  • Technical and strategic support for audits, assessments and regulatory initiatives.
  • Pioneering the adoption of innovative technologies that ensure resilience and continuity of global and industrial operations.
  • Direct influence on risk mitigation and support of corporate reputation and safety.


Additional Comments:

This specialist will act as a key player in the global security strategy, ensuring the protection of critical assets in complex and distributed environments, with integrated Brazil-Canada action. We encourage professionals with an innovative, collaborative attitude and focused on concrete results.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.G., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.


Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.


Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Contract CRA Project - 40 hours per week 1 year contract.

Seizure or Epilepsy - CNS


Job Summary:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to monitor and manage Phase 2 Seizure study clinical trials. The CRA will ensure the trial is conducted in compliance with regulatory standards, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and the study protocol. This position involves collaborating with investigators, site personnel, and cross-functional teams to ensure the safety and well-being of participants in early-phase clinical trials.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Site Management and Monitoring:
  • Conduct site qualification, initiation, interim monitoring, and close-out visits.
  • Ensure proper site adherence to protocols, GCP, and regulatory requirements.
  • Verify and ensure accurate data collection and reporting.
  • Assess site performance and provide corrective actions if necessary.
  • Regulatory Compliance:
  • Ensure all clinical trial documentation is maintained according to regulatory guidelines.
  • Review informed consent documents and confirm proper consenting procedures.
  • Collaborate with regulatory teams to ensure timely submissions and approvals.
  • Safety and Data Management:
  • Monitor and report adverse events (AEs), serious adverse events (SAEs), and dose-limiting toxicities.
  • Validate source data and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Ensure timely and accurate documentation of clinical trial data in electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Collaboration and Communication:
  • Build and maintain relationships with study investigators and site staff.
  • Communicate study updates and findings to study sponsors and internal teams.
  • Provide training to site personnel on study protocols, procedures, and GCP compliance.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences , Nursing , or a related field.
  • At least 2-4 years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate in oncology trials, with preference for Phase 2 experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) , FDA regulations, and ICH guidelines.
  • Experience with electronic data capture (EDC) systems and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).
  • Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience in early-phase oncology trials (e.G., dose escalation studies, first-in-human trials).
  • Strong understanding of pharmacokinetics (PK) and pharmacodynamics (PD) assessments.
  • Certification as a Clinical Research Professional (CCRA) is a plus.

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
Medical Science Liaison

Location: Recife / Brasilia

Field-based work model

At Sanofi, we are driven by one purpose – we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible.

We never settle and now we are creating a new paradigm with a first-in-class therapy in Autoimmune Diabetes (Type 1 Diabetes).

Our newest core asset, resulting from the acquisition of Prevention Bio in General Medicines Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes space, aims at delaying the onset of stage 3 type 1 diabetes. This means that for the first time, people at risk of developing this lifelong disease have fresh hope. What delayed onset means is more time for children to be children with less healthcare and more care-free childhood. The delay also gives families and healthcare professionals more time to prepare care plans for a later diagnosis.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly motivated and visionary scientific leader to serve as a MSL with expertise in for T1D. This role combines deep scientific expertise with strategic thinking to enhance the identification and management of people at risk of developing T1D, emphasizing the benefits of early detection and the use of new immunomodulators.

As a MSL - Autoimmune T1D Specialist, you will be the trusted scientific partner for external experts and decision-makers, while also contributing to the development and implementation of screening and monitoring strategies as well as engaging with experts in new therapies such as immunomodulators. This dual focus position will drive both scientific exchange and strategic initiatives to improve early identification and management of T1D.

Main ResponsibilitiesScientific Leadership & KOL Engagement
  • Serve as trusted scientific partner to key external experts (including KOLs, endocrinologists, pediatricians, and other scientific stakeholders), establishing and maintaining robust, long-term peer relationships
  • Conduct high-touch scientific exchange with experts from Centers of Excellence and beyond to convey a compelling and highly scientific narrative on T1D disease stages, importance of screening and treatment
  • Engage with experts to share scientific data, answer product-specific questions, and support them in developing best practices (e.G., infusion protocols)
  • Link internal partners to external thought leaders for education and research collaboration
  • Disseminate innovative medical education materials and foster medical/scientific information exchange within the medical community
  • Tailor engagement to different stakeholder segments based on comprehensive stakeholder mapping and local go-to-market model
  • Work with cross-functional teams to leverage an omnichannel approach, orchestrating high-touch and personalized engagement across innovative channels (e.G., social media, peer-to-peer communities, online portals)
Early Detection Strategy
  • Collaborate with medical teams to develop and implement evidence-based screening and monitoring protocols
  • Provide scientific expertise in the development of risk-identification strategies
  • Support the adaptation of global screening and monitoring strategies to local contexts
  • Contribute to the scientific validation of new testing methodologies and channels
  • Engage with experts to promote best practices in screening and early intervention
  • Promote experience sharing among key external experts to reinforce consensus on screening and treatment protocols at local level
Strategic Implementation
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in agile settings with self-organized teams around main customer accounts to improve patient pathways and remove barriers
  • Provide scientific input on screening partnerships and initiatives
  • Gather and analyze field insights to inform medical strategy and screening programs
  • Support Market Access teams in evidence-based discussions with regional payers, drug formulary committees, and key account decision-makers on clinical value and health economics
  • Coordinate and direct requests for ISS, RCT, Managed Access Programs to appropriate teams
  • Keep up-to-date on medical and scientific developments in the Type 1 Diabetes field
Individual Contributors
  • Maintain knowledge of and comply with the principles of Ethics and Integrity, Sanofi policies, and codes of conduct that regulate the pharmaceutical market.
  • Comply with and promote Sanofi's Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, with the objective of preventing accidents, avoiding health risks, promoting employee well-being, and reducing environmental impacts resulting from work activities.
  • Support Sanofi's Diversity and Inclusion strategy and initiatives to ensure that all employees and partners are treated with respect and receive equal opportunities.
About YouExperience
  • Minimum 3 years experience as MSL in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes area
  • Experience in T1D or immunology highly preferred
  • Background in clinical research or academic setting
  • Experience with population health initiatives or screening programs is a plus
Soft skills
  • Strategic thinking.
  • Business acumen.
  • Interpersonal relationship.
  • Transversal collaboration.
  • Learning agility.
  • Ability to build proper environment to enable Playing to Win culture to flourish.
Professional competencies
  • Strong analytical capabilities for data interpretation and insights generation
  • Excellence in scientific communication and presentation
  • Strategic thinking and ability to translate science into actionable insights
  • Strong collaboration skills for cross-functional teamwork
  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
  • Project management capabilities
Technical skills
  • Advanced understanding of T1D clinical science and current research
  • Expertise in interpreting and communicating complex scientific data
  • Knowledge of screening methodologies and monitoring protocols
  • Understanding of healthcare systems and population health approaches
Education
  • Advanced degree required (MD, PharmD, PhD) in relevant scientific or medical field
  • Additional training in public health or population health management preferred

Language: Advanced English required.

Why Should You Choose Us?
  • Be part of a purpose-driven organization that pursues the miracles of science to improve people's lives worldwide
  • Access comprehensive benefits including health insurance, life insurance, and pension plans aligned with market best practices
  • Enjoy flexible work arrangements that support work-life integration and well-being
  • Benefit from continuous learning and development opportunities through Sanofi University and specialized training programs
  • Be part of building a new concept in autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes by bringing early detection and the use of new immunomodulators capable of changing the course of the disease.
  • Join Brazil's largest and fastest-growing immunology franchise, playing a key role in the growth strategy and market leadership

Pursue Progress. Discover Extraordinary.

Progress wouldn't be possible without people;
people from different backgrounds, in different locations, performing different roles, but all united by a common goal: the desire to make miracles happen. You can become one of these people. Seek change, embrace new ideas, and explore all the opportunities we have to offer. Pursue progress and discover the extraordinary with us.

title: Advogado 0302
description:
Aqui na Athon, estamos transformando a maneira como pessoas e empresas utilizam energia. Focada em negócios de baixo carbono, a Athon nasceu da implantação de placas solares para geração distribuída de energia e hoje atua na gestão dos contratos, na implantação de novos empreendimentos e no desenvolvimento de um pipeline de geração de energia de baixo carbono, inclusive por meio de cooperativas de energia e autoconsumo remoto. Fundada em 2017, somos uma das maiores startups de energia limpa do Brasil já investimos aproximadamente R$ 300M em geração de energia fotovoltaica, operando usinas para clientes líderes nos segmentos onde atuam. Além disso, a Athon vem de forma consistente desenvolvendo estruturação financeira de seus negócios, inclusive por meio de emissão de green bonds, e oferecendo soluções digitais avançadas a seus diversos clientes, inclusive dentro de mobilidade e eficiência energética. Nossos executivos têm experiência internacional e são respeitados no setor, tendo realizado parcerias com gigantes como XP Investimentos e Siemens. Nossa área de tecnologia opera com avançadas tecnologias, como BIG Data, Analytics, Cloud Computing e stacks de última geração;
segue ampliando as plataformas de software em nuvem e gerando valor para o mercado. Somos uma empresa que busca transformar a forma com que a sociedade lida com a energia pela atuação nos segmentos de energias renováveis, eficiência energética e tecnologia. Temos uma sólida estrutura de capital, somos empreendedores e buscamos inovação. Estamos sediados em São Paulo e atuamos nacionalmente. Buscamos pessoas com perfil arrojado e inovador, que busquem crescimento pessoal e profissional, e sejam apaixonadas pela ideia de transformar o mundo através de seu trabalho. O profissional deve buscar viver e fortalecer uma empresa dinâmica, com uma curva acelerada de crescimento e que tem o desafio de estruturar processos e governança nos mais altos padrões.

  • Trabalhar com operações de M&A, governança corporativa, project finance (emissões de títulos de dívida e contratação de financiamentos)
  • Contratos em geral e societário
Qualificações e Conhecimentos
  • Pacote office
